model_annotation: Figure 4, titled “大模型语义空间的推理过程,” is a grouped bar chart with an overlaid line plot, designed to compare the training set size, validation set size, and accuracy rate across five distinct semantic reasoning categories: 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition). The horizontal axis lists these five categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis on the left, labeled from 0 to 1200 in increments of 200, represents the quantity of data samples (training and validation set sizes) with no explicit unit. The vertical axis on the right, ranging from 0 to 1 in increments of 0.1, represents the accuracy rate as a decimal value. For each category, two vertical bars are displayed: a blue bar indicating the training set size and an orange bar indicating the validation set size, with their exact numerical values labeled atop each bar. Additionally, a gray line connects the accuracy rate for each category, with its corresponding decimal value labeled near each data point. The training set sizes are 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 5 for the five categories respectively; validation set sizes are 250, 190, 40, 675, and 55; and accuracy rates are 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.692, 0.2852, and 0.3769. The chart visually emphasizes the disparity in data distribution and performance across categories, particularly highlighting the extremely low training set size for 同义识别 and the high accuracy for 角色识别 despite its relatively modest validation set size. The categories are not sorted by any numerical metric but appear to follow a thematic or logical sequence. The chart includes a legend in the top-right corner identifying the blue bars as “训练集数量,” the orange bars as “验证集数量,” and the gray line as “准确率.”
